title: Polygala tenuifolia willd. Extract alleviates LPS-induced acute lung injury in rats via TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway and NLRP3 inflammasome suppression.
authors: Guo, Shuyun; Zhang, Jianguang; Zhang, Qian; Xu, Shuang; Liu, Yuezhen; Ma, Shangzhi; Hu, Xiaodi; Liu, Yanju; Zhang, Xiuqiao; Jiang, Ruixue; Zhang, Zhifeng; Zhang, Zhihua; Zhou, Zhongshi; Wen, Li
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药远志提取物通过TLR4/NF-κB和NLRP3通路缓解急性肺损伤，仅用分子对接验证小分子与TLR4结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute lung injury (ALI) has received considerable attention in the field of critical care as it can lead to high mortality rates. Polygala tenuifolia, a traditional Chinese medicine with strong expectorant properties, can be used to treat pneumonia. Owing to the complexity of its composition, the main active ingredient is not yet known. Thus, there is a need to identify its constituent compounds and mechanism of action in the treatment of ALI using advanced technological means. PURPOSE: We investigated the anti-inflammatory mechanism and constituent compounds with regard to the effect of P. tenuifolia Willd. extract (EPT) in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced ALI in vivo and in vitro. METHODS: The UHPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS technology was used to investigate the chemical profile of EPT. Network pharmacology was used to predict the targets and pathways of action of EPT in ALI, and molecular docking was used to validate the binding of polygalacic acid to Toll-like receptor (TLR) 4. The main compounds were determined using LC-MS. A rat model of LPS-induced ALI was established, and THP-1 cells were stimulated with LPS and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) to construct an in vitro model. Pathological changes were observed using hematoxylin and eosin staining, Wright-Giemsa staining, and immunohistochemistry. The expression of inflammatory factors (NE, MPO, Ly-6 G, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and iNOS) was determined using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, real-time fluorescence quantitative polymerase chain reaction, and western blotting. The LPS + ATP-induced inflammation model in THP-1 cells was used to verify the in vivo experimental results. RESULTS: Ninety-nine compounds were identified or tentatively deduced from EPT. Using network pharmacology, we found that TLR4/NF-kappaB may be a relevant pathway for the prevention and treatment of ALI by EPT. Polygalacic acid in EPT may be a potential active ingredient. EPT could alleviate LPS-induced histopathological lung damage and reduce the wet/dry lung weight ratio in the rat model of ALI. Moreover, EPT decreased the white blood cell and neutrophil counts in the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and decreased the expression of genes and proteins of relevant inflammatory factors (NE, MPO, Ly-6 G, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and iNOS) in lung tissues. It also increased the expression of endothelial-type nitric oxide synthase expression. Western blotting confirmed that EPT may affect TLR4/NF-kappaB and NLRP3 signaling pathways in vivo. Similar results were obtained in THP-1 cells. CONCLUSION: EPT reduced the release of inflammatory factors by affecting TLR4/NF-kappaB and NLRP3 signaling pathways, thereby attenuating the inflammatory response of ALI. Polygalacic acid is the likely compounds responsible for these effects.
abstract_zh: 背景：急性肺损伤（ALI）在重症监护领域受到广泛关注，因其可导致高死亡率。远志（Polygala tenuifolia）是一种具有较强祛痰作用的传统中药，可用于治疗肺炎。由于其成分复杂，主要活性成分尚不明确。因此，有必要利用先进技术手段鉴定其组成化合物及其在治疗ALI中的作用机制。目的：我们研究了远志提取物（EPT）在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的ALI体内和体外模型中的抗炎机制及组成化合物。方法：采用UHPLC-Q-Exactive Orbitrap MS技术研究EPT的化学特征。利用网络药理学预测EPT在ALI中的作用靶点和通路，并通过分子对接验证远志酸与Toll样受体（TLR）4的结合。主要化合物通过LC-MS确定。建立LPS诱导的ALI大鼠模型，并用LPS和三磷酸腺苷（ATP）刺激THP-1细胞构建体外模型。通过苏木精-伊红染色、Wright-Giemsa染色和免疫组化观察病理变化。使用酶联免疫吸附测定、实时荧光定量聚合酶链反应和蛋白质印迹法测定炎症因子（NE、MPO、Ly-6 G、TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6和iNOS）的表达。使用LPS+ATP诱导的THP-1细胞炎症模型验证体内实验结果。结果：从EPT中鉴定或初步推断出99种化合物。通过网络药理学，我们发现TLR4/NF-κB可能是EPT预防和治疗ALI的相关通路。EPT中的远志酸可能是潜在活性成分。EPT可减轻LPS诱导的ALI大鼠模型的组织病理学肺损伤，并降低肺湿/干重比。此外，EPT降低了支气管肺泡灌洗液中的白细胞和中性粒细胞计数，并降低了肺组织中相关炎症因子（NE、MPO、Ly-6 G、TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6和iNOS）的基因和蛋白表达。它还增加了内皮型一氧化氮合酶的表达。蛋白质印迹法证实EPT可能影响体内TLR4/NF-κB和NLRP3信号通路。在THP-1细胞中获得了类似结果。结论：EPT通过影响TLR4/NF-κB和NLRP3信号通路减少炎症因子的释放，从而减轻ALI的炎症反应。远志酸可能是产生这些效应的主要化合物。
